text.en: Anyone with Meter Logs access can add readings and correct ordinary entries. Lower readings save for Admin review without reducing current fleet meters. Flagged readings require an audited Admin review.
Maintenance plans can verify a fleet vehicle, show matching service templates and applicable meters, and calculate the next due date or reading from the last service and its interval.

Approval, administration and import workflows now have their required backend services. Access Control capability saves use company settings while retaining existing permission rules and feature flags.
Monthly checklist history includes older sheets synced later, using the date recorded on the checklist. The submissions list distinguishes checklist and received dates.
Inspection planning now consistently warns when loaded history reaches its limit.
Approval reviews clear outdated permissions and show completed decisions accurately. Policy publishing checks the reviewed draft, stage deadlines and simulation results.
Work-order approval requests retain the same retry after a refresh or reopening. Tyre changes recheck access, verify server receipts and show the approved operation before execution.
Inspection planning has a searchable work queue, clearer appointment and coverage status, timezone-safe scheduling, bulk appointment previews, and visible validation and save errors.
Inspection PDFs distinguish latest fleet estimates from inspection readings, flag unmapped wheel positions, and avoid false short-life tyre alerts.
Checklists flag contradictory fitness answers and invalid historical meters. New submissions reject negative meter readings, and signature headings stay with their signatures.
Anomaly scans separate countries and currencies, handle numeric costs correctly, and warn when workshop records are unavailable.
Tyre and vehicle histories load more completely, respect the selected country, and report unavailable history.
Country changes discard outdated results, and operational pages follow module access settings.
Maintenance and shift lists include later records and report loading failures more clearly.
Filtered record downloads show errors for incomplete exports and prevent repeated download clicks.
See what changed before updating, and find previous releases in Settings > Update history.
Washing PDFs fit a single wash and three larger photos on one page, with clearer vehicle details.
Wash downloads follow the selected filters. Download messages can be closed and disappear automatically.
Your home shows permitted modules and avoids loading unrelated dashboard data.
Data Monitor navigation, search and page access now follow the permissions saved in Settings.
Update kilometres and engine hours in the same vehicle row. Reading warnings appear when saving.
Fleet Supervisors can schedule and log vehicle washes. Export vehicle washing PDFs with uploaded photos.
